hypothesis: Matched N=64 reference arm (fresh seeds 65-69, e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-5 controls, 5-step checkpoints), paired with an N=256 arm on the same seeds. Every formation step is read from the per-checkpoint trajectory, not from formed_at_step. accel_step forms persistently (the first checkpoint after which the margin stays >= required_margin at every later checkpoint) within steps 70-110, and reaches half of its own final margin within steps 50-100. This reproduces the N=64 timing seen in seeds 47-49, 56-58 and 62-64 (persistent 80-100).
expected_if_true: At least 4 of 5 seeds have a persistent 0.1-bar formation step in [70, 110] and a half-final-margin step in [50, 100]. Final layer-4 accel_step margin is >= 0.1 in all seeds, and force does not beat its control at the final checkpoint.
expected_if_false: At least 2 of 5 seeds have a persistent 0.1-bar formation step outside [70, 110] (for example <= 65 or >= 115), or a half-final step outside [50, 100]. Either result would mean the N=64 reference window is too narrow to anchor the paired comparison.
